review_candidates.title: Linux System Administrator
review_candidates.description: The Infrastructure & Platforms Engineer will be responsible for administering, automating, and supporting enterprise Linux and infrastructure environments, with a primary focus on RHEL, Red Hat Satellite, and Ansible Automation . The role will ensure the availability, security, performance, patching, and lifecycle management of Linux platforms across production, non-production, and DR environments while supporting virtualization, storage, backup, networking, and other enterprise infrastructure technologies. Responsibilities Administer and support enterprise RHEL environments across production, non-production, and DR platforms. Perform Linux installation, configuration, patching, upgrades, hardening, performance tuning, and troubleshooting. Manage Linux users, groups, filesystems, LVM, services, processes, permissions, SSH, SELinux, and system security. Manage the RHEL lifecycle using Red Hat Satellite , including host registration, repositories, Content Views, Lifecycle Environments, Activation Keys, errata, and subscription management. Plan and execute enterprise Linux patching, remediation, and compliance activities through Satellite. Develop and maintain Ansible playbooks, roles, inventories, variables, templates, and handlers for infrastructure automation. Automate server provisioning, configuration management, patching, compliance, application prerequisites, and routine operational activities using Ansible. Support and troubleshoot Ansible Automation Platform / Ansible Tower/AWX environments and failed automation jobs. Troubleshoot complex Linux OS, networking, filesystem, performance, and infrastructure-related issues. Support Linux HA/cluster environments and related technologies where applicable. Administer and troubleshoot VMware vSphere/ESXi environments, including VM provisioning, migration, snapshots, resource management, and HA. Support enterprise SAN/NAS storage , including Fibre Channel, LUNs, multipathing, NFS, and storage provisioning. Support enterprise backup and recovery environments using Commvault, Veeam, or equivalent technologies. Participate in infrastructure migration, technology refresh, DR, capacity planning, and platform upgrade projects. Monitor infrastructure health, availability, capacity, and performance. Perform root-cause analysis and implement permanent solutions for recurring infrastructure issues. Coordinate with OEM and vendor support teams for Linux, hardware, virtualization, storage, backup, and platform-related issues. Maintain infrastructure documentation, SOPs, technical procedures, and operational runbooks. Participate in incident, problem, change, and release management processes. Provide technical support during critical production activities and planned maintenance. Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or a related discipline . 5+ years of relevant experience in enterprise infrastructure and Linux administration. Strong hands-on experience with RHEL 7/8/9 or later . Strong expertise in Linux system administration and troubleshooting . Hands-on experience with Red Hat Satellite , including Content Views, Lifecycle Environments, Activation Keys, repositories, host registration, errata, and patch management. Strong practical experience with Ansible and development of playbooks, roles, inventories, variables, templates, and handlers. Experience with Ansible Automation Platform / Ansible Tower/AWX is preferred. Good knowledge of LVM, filesystems, systemd, SELinux, SSH, RPM/YUM/DNF, NFS, DNS/NTP, Linux networking, user/access management, and Bash scripting. Experience with Linux security hardening, vulnerability remediation, and OS performance monitoring. Hands-on experience with VMware vSphere/ESXi ; exposure to Hyper-V is an advantage. Good understanding of enterprise SAN/NAS, Fibre Channel, LUNs, multipathing, and NFS . Experience with Commvault, Veeam, or equivalent backup technologies and understanding of backup, recovery, DR, RPO, and RTO concepts. Good understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, NTP, VLANs, routing, firewalls, load balancing, and Linux network configuration. Exposure to Red Hat OpenShift/Kubernetes is an advantage. Strong troubleshooting, analytical, communication, documentation, and problem-solving skills. Ability to work independently and collaborate with cross-functional infrastructure and application teams. Willingness to participate in on-call and after-hours support when required. RHCSA/RHCE, Red Hat Ansible Automation, VMware VCP, or ITIL certification is preferred.
